title: Zero-error polynomial time class
statement: The class $\mathrm{ZPP}$ is the union, over all natural numbers $c$, of the classes of Boolean languages decidable by a nondeterministic Turing machine in time $c(n^c+1)$ on inputs of length $n$.
hypotheses_covered: The exponent $c$ ranges over natural numbers
The time bound is $c(n^c+1)$ for each such $c$
The language is over the Boolean alphabet and is decided by a nondeterministic Turing machine within the stated bound
